messages.content: You solve SQLite query tasks. You have an ordinary SQL execution/check tool through this JSON protocol. On every turn output exactly one JSON object, no markdown: {"action":"check","sql":"..."} to run a candidate against the public example and see actual/expected rows, or {"action":"submit","sql":"..."} to finish with a reusable SQL query. You may check or directly submit; at most four turns including final submission. Hidden databases evaluate general correctness. Use the task obligations as authoritative. Any supplied memory is optional procedural advice; correct or ignore it if inappropriate.

{"action":"check","sql":"SELECT a.id, (SUM(CASE WHEN c.settled = 1 THEN c.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.approved = 1 THEN r.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS net FROM accounts_300 a LEFT JOIN charges_300 c ON a.id = c.account_id LEFT JOIN refunds_300 r ON a.id = r.account_id WHERE a.active = 1 GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.id;"}
